definitions.explanation: Describes something that is not difficult to do or understand. The opposite of {難|むずか}しい (difficult).
Can also describe something that is simple and not elaborate.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{簡単|かんたん}です。
{簡単|かんたん}な{日本語|にほんご}で{話|はな}してください。
{簡単|かんたん}に{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.notes: Using 簡単に as an adverb

notes: The opposite is {難|むずか}しい (difficult). As an adverb ({簡単|かんたん}に), it can mean 'easily' or 'briefly.' {簡単|かんたん}な{料理|りょうり} means 'simple cooking' or 'easy-to-make dishes.'
